# Chapter 1 Motion

This chapter introduces motion in a straight line for Grade 10 Physics.

## Uniform motion

Definition. Uniform motion is motion with constant velocity.

Example 1: A bus travels 60 km in 1 hour at a steady speed. Average speed is 60 km/h.

| Quantity | Symbol | SI unit |
| -------- | ------ | ------- |
| Displacement | s | m |
| Velocity | v | m/s |

```
v = s / t
```

Q1. What is the SI unit of velocity?

Answer: metre per second (m/s).

## Non-uniform motion

When speed changes with time, the motion is non-uniform.
